job.job_description:
Job Description :
AI Engineer to build and implement AI agents/ Architecture within CI/CD workflows on AWS.
Over-All Experience Level : 8+ Yrs
A.I. Exp. : Min. 3+ years

Required Skills
Must Have :
Hands-on with LLMs / GenAI (OpenAI, Bedrock, or similar)
Strong experience in Python and AI development
RAG Pipeline Engineering (SageMaker + Lambda)
MCP Server Development & Tool Integrations
Experience building agentic workflows or autonomous AI agents
Exposure to code generation / code fixing using LLMs
Experience with vector databases
Good knowledge of AWS services (Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, API Gateway)
Understanding of application security & vulnerabilities
Good to have / Preferred :
Understanding and exposure of CI/CD tools (GitHub, Jenkins, Harness etc.) & security tools (Snyk, SonarQube, etc.)
Knowledge of containerization & orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
Prior work in security automation or remediation systems
